{{redirect|Charcadet (POKÉTOON)|the other Charcadet from the same episode|Yūto's Charcadet}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox |pokemonname=Ceruledge |type1=Fire |type2=Ghost |ball=None |nickname=Ceruledge {{shinystar|SV}} |jnickname=ソウブレイズ |tmnickname=Soublades |image=[[File:Shiny Ceruledge PT.png|250px]] |caption=Ceruledge |gender=Unknown |ability=Unknown |caught=no |evolution=1 |epnum=PT16 |epname= |firstevoep=PT16 |firstevoname= |numeps1=less than 1 |firststagename=Charcadet |prevonum=0935 s |evo1num=0937 s |shiny=yes |current=[[Paldea]] |java1=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Yumiri Hanamori]] |enva1=N/A |java2=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Yumiri Hanamori]] |enva2=N/A }} '''Ceruledge''' (Japanese: '''ソウブレイズ''' ''Soublades'') is one of the main characters of [[PT16]]. It is a [[Shiny Pokémon]]. ==History== [[File:PT16.png|250px|thumb|left|{{Shiny}} Charcadet (right) and its [[Yūto's Armarouge|friend]] (left)]] {{p|Ceruledge}} was once a wild {{p|Charcadet}} that traveled alongside its non-{{Shiny}} [[Yūto's Armarouge|Charcadet]] friend. The two were seen trying to reach some [[Sitrus Berry|Sitrus Berries]] up on a tree, but fell short every single time. Driven by hunger, the non-Shiny Charcadet robbed a passing traveler of his [[sandwich]] without him noticing. Although initially refusing to share the reward, it gave half the meal to its friend when its stomach growled. Later, while playing in [[West Province (Area Three)]], the two came across a [[Rotom Phone]]. The device flew into regular-colored Charcadet's face and began to display clips of a battle tournament held in [[Mesagoza]]. The battles enthralled it so much it failed to notice the phone's owner, {{OBP|Yūto|POKÉTOON}}, approaching it, though Shiny Charcadet hid between a tree. Yūto challenged it to a battle for the phone with his {{p|Shroomish}}. The normal-colored Charcadet was quickly overwhelmed, and although nervous, the Shiny Charcadet climbed a tree to grab a Sitrus Berry and help. By the time it did so, however, Yūto had defeated regular-colored Charcadet and offered it a spot on its team. Left alone, Shiny Charcadet watched as its friend abandoned it. [[File:Malicious Armor PT.png|250px|thumb|left|The [[Malicious Armor]] Charcadet used to evolve]] Charcadet traveled through the [[region]] to try and find its friend, but did not accomplish it, and eventually sought refuge inside an abandoned building and made its home there. One day, it came back from foraging to discover four {{p|Bronzor}} and a {{p|Gengar}}, which had been eating its food. Gengar easily overwhelmed it in {{pkmn|battle}}, so Charcadet, remembering being abandoned and compelled by a nearby set of [[Malicious Armor]], steeled its resolve and broke free. It touched the Malicious Armor and evolved into Ceruledge. Harnessing its newfound power, it used a combination of {{m|Shadow Claw}} and {{m|Bitter Blade}} to triumph over its foes. [[File:Yuto Armarouge vs Shiny Ceruledge.png|250px|thumb|Ceruledge battling Armarouge]] Some time later, a new battle tournament began in Mesagoza. Ceruledge ventured there, knowing that it would find its former friend. It waited on the battlefield until Armarouge and Yūto arrived. Locking eyes, Ceruledge immediately attacked the Fire Warrior Pokémon. Armarouge attempted to counter, but Ceruledge used its speed and a nearby {{p|Grimmsnarl}} as a shield. It was then that Armarouge realized the Ceruledge was its former friend, Charcadet. Ceruledge retreated to the rooftops, and Armarouge followed on its own. Both parties exchanged blow after blow before unleashing their final attack and landing back on the battlefield. Although it looked as if Armarouge was about to lose, Ceruledge ended up collapsing. With the fight over, Armarouge laid next to Ceruledge and the two shared a laugh together for the first time in ages. Yūto, realizing the two were close, offered Ceruledge a spot on his team. The Shiny Pokémon refused, having accepted that their paths no longer aligned. The two separated once more, this time having a proper goodbye. Later on, Ceruledge was shown to have returned to the abandoned building and befriended the Bronzor and Gengar. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Yuto Armarouge and Shiny Ceruledge.png|thumb|250px|Armarouge and Ceruledge reconciling after their battle]] [[File:Shiny Ceruledge friends PT.png|thumb|left|250px|Ceruledge and its friends]] As a Charcadet, it was shy and tended to hide from anyone but its friend. This timid nature led to it depending on its regular-colored Charcadet friend to handle situations. After being abandoned, however, it grew bold enough to brave scary situations. Upon accepting that its friend had left it for good, it shed its shy personality and gained a newfound set of confidence. In battle, it was not afraid to use dirty tactics, such as using another Pokémon as a shield. It cared greatly for its regular-colored Charcadet friend, searching all across [[Paldea]] to reunite with it and crying when it believed it had found it. Eventually its abandonment turned to resentment, and it sought out its friend not to reunite, but for revenge. Upon being defeated, however, it accepted that they each had different paths to walk and parted on good terms. {{-}} ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fire color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{fire color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{fire color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a Charcadet |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Shiny Charcadet PT.png|250px]] |} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|Fire|Ghost|Shiny {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Charcadet Ember|1=Ceruledge Shadow Claw|2=Ceruledge Bitter Blade|3=Ceruledge Psycho Cut}} PT.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Ember as a Charcadet|1=Shadow Claw|2=Bitter Blade|3=Psycho Cut}}}} {{anmov|Fire|Ember|PT16|}} {{anmov|Ghost|Shadow Claw|PT16|}} {{anmov|Fire|Bitter Blade|PT16|}} {{anmov|Psychic|Psycho Cut|PT16|}} {{anmov/f|Ghost}} ==Artwork== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{ghost color dark}}; background: #{{fire color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{fire color dark}}; background: #{{fire color light}}" | [[File:PT16 title card.png|x150px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{ghost color dark}}; background: #{{fire color light}}" | [[File:PT16 Ending splash.png|x150px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{ghost color dark}}; background: #{{fire color light}}" | [[File:PT16 Special Art.png|x150px]] |- | Title card for {{color2|000|PT16}} | Ending splash for {{color2|000|PT16}} | Artwork for {{color2|000|PT16}} by
